script: You do not need an expensive machine. There are four tiers: a basic laptop for learning, a desktop with a used 12-gigabyte N V I D I A card for real work, and a 24-gigabyte card for heavy jobs. When you buy a used card, check its memory, its power supply, and whether it has been used for mining.
